Overview

Built an intelligent demand forecasting and inventory optimization system for a multi-million dollar retail operation, transforming reactive inventory management into predictive, data-driven decision-making.

The Challenge

The retail chain struggled with inventory waste from overstocking and lost revenue from stockouts. Manual forecasting methods couldn't handle seasonal patterns, promotional impacts, and complex product interdependencies.

Our Solution

Deployed time-series ML models analyzing historical sales, seasonal trends, promotional calendars, weather patterns, and external market signals. The system provides automated daily forecasts with confidence intervals, enabling optimized ordering decisions and dynamic inventory allocation across locations.

Technology Stack

BigQueryProphetLooker

Google BigQuery for cloud data warehouse, Prophet (Facebook) for time-series forecasting, Python (Pandas, Statsmodels) for statistical analysis, Looker for BI dashboards, GCP Cloud Functions for automated forecasting runs, Cloud Scheduler for daily batch jobs, BigQuery ML for in-warehouse model training, Pub/Sub for event-driven alerts.

Impact & Results

87%Forecast Accuracy

  • Achieved 87% forecast accuracy across all SKUs
  • Reduced inventory waste by 40% through precise demand prediction
  • Decreased stockout incidents by 65%
  • Accelerated sourcing decisions and improved supplier negotiations
